command: l9-harness --json assurance --executable <real l9-assurance> --invocations <dir> admit --subject <SDK-derived subject> --input <real SDK observation> --output <dir>

positive_evidence.invoked_real_assurance: pass - the harness executed the real l9-assurance binary; exit_code 0.
positive_evidence.assurance_output_preserved: pass - admission-report.json records accepted=1, rejected=0, identical to the direct Seam B admission of the same real SDK observation.
positive_evidence.non_authoritative_marker: pass - invocation-record.json (schema l9.assurance-invocation-record) carries "authoritative": false explicitly.
positive_evidence.did_not_fork_verdict: pass - the harness recorded stdoutDigest/stderrDigest/argvDigest and the child exit code; it computed no admission decision of its own.

harness_does_not_pass_when_assurance_mis.evidence: With --executable /nonexistent/l9-assurance the harness returned status='fail', exit_code=40, reason_codes=['HARNESS_INPUT_INVALID']. It did not fabricate a pass.
